disclaimer: Fair-line results price every bet at the no-vig number, which isolates model skill from execution. They are a benchmark, not a P&L — real results depend on the prices you actually get, when you bet, and whether you take every suggestion. The actual-price column uses the odds the pipeline logged.

career.note: All-time pools every bet the pipeline has ever logged, across model versions. The combined line is the record of the process; the by-version table is the record of each model. A version change means a different model choosing a different set of games, so the versions are not interchangeable and the pooled ROI should never be read as the current model's edge.
